mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal ineffective monetary policy, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales (RSAFS) exceeding 450,000 million dollars signals late-cycle expansion with stretched valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000.

mechanism_narrative: A low Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL < 235) indicates disinflation, reducing monetary tightening risk and supporting equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 235.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts (HOUST > 1200.0 thousand units) and weak industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signal demand-supply mismatch, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0 and INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 105.0) reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0.
